# Hyperion

> Magento 2 storefront theme and module suite built with Tailwind CSS 3.4, Lit 3 Web Components and HTMX 2 over Varnish ESI. No RequireJS, jQuery or Knockout. MIT. Version 0.9.0-beta.3 (beta). Supports Magento 2.4.7 to 2.4.9 and Mage-OS, PHP 8.3 to 8.5.

Website: https://hyperionfront.dev
Live demo: https://demo.hyperionfront.dev
Repository: https://github.com/magentofullstackdev/hyperion
Composer repository: https://magentofullstackdev.github.io/hyperion/
npm packages: @magentofullstackdev/hyperion-shared, @magentofullstackdev/hyperion-theme, @magentofullstackdev/hyperion-checkout

## Start here

- [README](README.md): what you get, requirements, quick install, status, limitations in short
- [Install](docs/install.md): Composer repository, minimum-stability beta, the modules and the theme, image cache commands, the checkout flag
- [Configuration](docs/configuration.md): every Hyperion setting in the admin, languages, images, search, mega menu
- [Known limitations](docs/known-limitations.md): what the beta does not cover
- [Compatibility](docs/compatibility.md): tested platforms, PHP versions, test counts
- [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md): releases

## Build on it

- [Child themes](docs/child-themes.md): the `hyperion create Vendor/Theme` CLI, tokens, Tailwind preset, components
- [Checkout and payment renderers](docs/checkout.md): the Lit checkout, its REST client, renderers, translations
- [PageBuilder](docs/pagebuilder.md): how PageBuilder content renders without RequireJS
- [Varnish and caching](docs/varnish.md): the VCL, ESI, what is cached, invalidation
- [Architecture](ARCHITECTURE.md): the request path, the header state request, HTMX actions, listings, assets, extension points
